notes: Boot launch now starts hidden in the tray, with an update notification
patch_notes:
Start with Windows now starts GameMode VPN minimized in the system tray — no window at boot. The startup entry refreshes itself on the first launch of this version, so no settings change is needed.
If an update is available while the app sits in the tray, you now get a tray notification ('update available') instead of a banner you cannot see; open the app when you want to install it. The What's New dialog also waits for a visible launch instead of popping up at boot.
